correctness.rationale: For exactly T=conv(signed coordinate permutations of (0,1,2)), square faces have area 2 and hexagonal faces 3sqrt(3). Cauchy projection yields b(u)=2 sum|u_i|+(3/2)sum_{8 signs}|eps.u|. Sorting |u| as a>=b>=c gives 14a+2b+2c if a>=b+c and 8(a+b+c) otherwise. The two polyhedral cones are generated respectively by (1,0,0),(1,1,0),(2,1,1) and (1,1,0),(2,1,1),(1,1,1); strict normalized ray minimum is 8sqrt(2) at (1,1,0). Cauchy-Schwarz gives maximum 2sqrt(51) uniquely in chamber a>=b+c at (7,1,1), all sign permutations understood. The support function is the Minkowski sum of centered segments generated by three 2e_i and four 3eps diagonals. Direct independent integer enumeration of all 35 triple determinants gives axis-count sums {0:432,1:432,2:144,3:8}, so the standard three-dimensional zonotope volume identity gives 8*(1016)=8128. Rescaling T/sqrt(2) gives the stated edge-one values. The analytic chamber proof controls every direction; 47 independent projected hull directions were only corroboration.
